framework_findings: GM->L1 strided reads are a FIRST-CLASS expert-mode citizen, symmetric to the iter8 UB->GM strided writes: src/op/ascend.cc compute_strideN automatically folds trailing singleton region dims into realSrcN, so a BSND box X[bz, rows, head, :] lowers to ONE copy_gm_to_l1 with realSrcN = D*N (no UB staging, no instruction-count change, ND->NZ is an MTE2 on-the-fly transform via Catlass TileCopyTla). Measured cost on the prefill paced loop: +0.3..+1.5us per main invocation (0.5-2.6%), fully absorbed by the K/V double-buffer prefetch — the decode production kernel (strided K/V at 87-94% of the MTE2 roof) was the correct prior.

Eliminating transpose_qkv makes the covered chains SINGLE-KERNEL (BSND in -> BSND out): 7/20 bench cases now launch exactly one kernel per call. The full-tqkv-benefit economic model (benefit = eliminated TaskDur in full, e2e=SUM-TaskDur口径) transferred from wave-1 calibration to the READ side within -1.6..+0.5pp on all five measured shapes — aux-kernel elimination is the highest-certainty lever family in this operator (three consecutive rounds: P1 retile, P2 output wave-1/2, P4 input).

The in_bsnd capability pattern required ONE structural adapter change beyond the iter8 out_bsnd template: kernel resolution had to move ABOVE the input transpose (the capability flag decides whether transpose_qkv runs). Pure host reordering (gqa_expert depends only on shapes; NPU launch order unchanged), but it is the general shape of any INPUT-side skip: resolve-then-supply, with a single gate variable (in_bsnd_eff) driving BOTH the spec-builder kwarg and the adapter skip — dual-driven gates silently corrupt non-aligned shapes (Gate-0 harness defect caught by the isolation cases; tilelang does NOT validate input tensor shapes against declarations).

The dual-alignment gate (S%64==0 AND S_kv%128==0) is strictly stronger than out_bsnd's: S_kv non-alignment needs transpose_qkv's in-kernel zero-fill columns (padcol semantics + use_mask), which a strided direct read cannot synthesize without invading the paced loop. Non-aligned shapes keep the shipped chain bit-identically (padcol_skv200 + padrow_s100 isolation evidence).

AUTO vid-reduction applicability (iter9 finding 1) declared for the READ side: the demonstrated defect is on UB->GM strided WRITES under AUTO threads=2; GM->L1 strided READS under AUTO vid-splitting are UNTESTED (probe never touched AUTO kernels) — per-head domain conservatively EXCLUDED, same treatment as iter9. g2stack/prefill_expert (expert manual-flag) are mechanism-compatible and remain for a next wave (c19 = 33% tqkv share, the largest single remaining aux item on the bench).
